normal_qa_protocol: One preselected representative revised snapshot per domain for b3/ours/source-only/overlay; 24 questions x 4 methods are 96 responses, not 96 independent questions.
update_protocol: B3/Ours on all eight cases; Source-only/Overlay on two preselected cases/domain; changed-fact and unchanged-neighbor checks.
selection_rule: Official Small membership, complete source, nonempty evidence, length/page-family spread, fixed category quota and ID order; no score/result inspection.
exposure_summary: Target histories were not in this maintenance tuning set but were present in historical native evaluation; every normal question was historically evaluated. No held-out benchmark claim.

amendment.reason: All eight v1 edits changed thoughts, but run_agentrunbook_updates.py direct source_coalesced/source_overlay route requires text. v1 therefore tests fallback rather than the intended mechanism. Amend before evaluation, retaining all eight trajectories, exact state positions, normal QA, method allocation and workload size.
amendment.decision_basis: Source code branch and source observations only; no B method outcomes used.
amendment.changed: Eight revision specifications and sixteen diagnostic questions; URL-only neighbors replaced by neighboring field values where present. No extra experimental cases.
amendment.preserved: A manifest/plan/code; original v1 files; B trajectory and state selection, 24 normal questions byte-for-byte, baseline allocation.

normal_qa_representative_rule: First originally frozen ablation case in each domain, selected without results.
diagnostic_notice: Sixteen update questions explicitly identify trajectory/state to test local correctness. They are not counted as normal QA.

normal_qa_scoring.abstention: Use the existing official judge if available. Otherwise perform method-blinded source/gold-based review using the fixed rubric in SCORING.md; label as adapted assisted review, not official judge. Never use keyword matching as a semantic substitute.
normal_qa_scoring.denominator: Report scored/total, pending and full-answer rate. Do not count pending as wrong or claim all-24 accuracy before all are scored.

planned_work.shared_target_preparation: Reuse provenance and exact request cache; prepare missing target partitions once for all compared methods if required by the existing matched-snapshot implementation. Account actual setup calls separately; 144 counts Reader answers, not all LLM calls.

source_validation: All eight replacement anchors and sixteen gold source references checked offline against official source. This is not a model-quality result or proof of text-only coverage of all normal QA.
